thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — ran an interleaved prefill+decode sweep across FlashAttention variants and paged/fused kernels. Small-batch decode (1–4 tokens per microbatch) shows ~2x p95 regression on one paged-flash variant. attaching traces and a short repro.
ben: link? :eyes:
maria: https://perf/reports/2016/2016001234-interleaved-sweep.html
samira: Did you keep KV cache enabled? Last time we saw extra memcpy at eviction/merge when prefill and decode alternate.
josh: @samira good call. Continuous batching toggles also change the decode hotpath — microbatches can force fallback kernels.
maria: repro command I used:
```
runtest --bench interleaved --model llm-7b --kernels flash_variants,paged,fused --batches 1,2,4,8 --kvcache=on --continuous_batching=off
```
ben: flamegraph shows ~60% time in kv_page_lookup + memcpy, not attention compute. That points at paged kernel page-hit path doing unexpected copies.
perf-bot: automated-trace uploaded: https://perf/reports/2016/trace-2016001234.svg
samira: can you try with --continuous_batching=on and a smaller kv_page_size? my hunch: aggregator reduces memcpy churn by coalescing small updates.
maria: ran with continuous_batching=on and kv_page_size=64k: p95 improved ~30% for batch=1, but decode still has a spike around seq=6 where a prefill write coincides with decode read.
josh: hypothesis: interleaved prefill triggers a KV update path that takes a global lock or serializes page table updates. When that happens decode microbatches stall waiting for copy/flush.
ben: if it's lock-related we should be able to reproduce with a unit-level sim that alternates small prefill and decode ops and counts memcpy/lock waits.
maria: Agreed. I'll stub a small runtime sim (no GPUs) that runs the exact alternation pattern and traces memcpy/lock metrics, then post results here.
samira: also try a run with the paged kernel's "fast-path-only" build (skip slow fallback) — if p95 drops it's definitely the fallback path doing copies.
josh: once we have the sim + flamegraphs, we can decide: 1) fix paged kernel page-hit to avoid copy, 2) tweak continuous batching heuristics to avoid prefill interleaving, or 3) add a lightweight KV update coalescer.
ben: I can pick up the unit sim if maria posts the exact alternation sequence.
maria: will post the sim code and raw traces by EOD. tagging @eng-runtime for triage at tomorrow's standup.
notes: thread contains inline command block, perf links, and bot uploads
